BillHeading.BriefDescription: Modifying the issuance of collector vehicle license plates.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the issuance of collector vehicle license plates; amending RCW 46.18.220; reenacting and amending RCW 46.18.220; providing an effective date; and providing an expiration date.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 46.18.220 and 2011 c 243 s 1 and 2011 c 171 s 70 are each reenacted and amended to read as follows:Collector vehicle license plates. (Effective until January 1, 2017.)
BillSection.P: (1) A registered owner may apply to the department, county auditor or other agent, or subagent appointed by the director for a collector vehicle license plate for a motor vehicle that is at least thirty years old. The motor vehicle must be operated primarily as a collector vehicle and be in good running order. The applicant for the collector vehicle license plate shall:
(a) Purchase a registration for the motor vehicle as required under chapters 46.16A and 46.17 RCW; and
(b) Pay the special license plate fee established under RCW 46.17.220(1)(d) (f), in addition to any other fees or taxes required by law.
(2)(a) A person applying for a collector vehicle license plate for a vehicle manufactured in or before 1986 may:
(a) (i) Receive a collector vehicle license plate assigned by the department; or
(b) (ii) Provide an actual Washington state issued license plate designated for general use in the year of the vehicle's manufacture.

P.TextRun: (b) A person applying for a collector vehicle license plate for a vehicle manufactured in or after 1987 must be issued a collector vehicle license plate assigned by the department.

BillSection.P: (3) Collector vehicle license plates:
(a) Are valid for the life of the motor vehicle;
(b) Are not required to be renewed; and
(c) Must be displayed on the rear of the motor vehicle.
(4) A collector vehicle registered under this section may only be used for participation in club activities, exhibitions, tours, parades, and occasional pleasure driving.

(5) Collector vehicle license plates under subsection (2)(b) of this section may be transferred from one motor vehicle to another motor vehicle described in subsection (1) of this section upon application to the department, county auditor or other agent, or subagent appointed by the director.

(6) Any person who knowingly provides a false or facsimile license plate under subsection (2)(b) (a)(ii) of this section is subject to a traffic infraction and fine in an amount equal to the monetary penalty for a violation of RCW 46.16A.200(7)(b). Additionally, the person must pay for the cost of a collector vehicle license plate as listed in RCW 46.17.220(1)(d) (f), unless already paid.

RevNote.NoteP: Reviser's note: *(1) RCW 46.17.220 was amended by 2012 c 65 § 4, changing subsection (1)(d) to subsection (1)(e), effective January 1, 2013. RCW 46.17.220 was subsequently amended by 2014 c 77 § 2, changing subsection (1)(e) to subsection (1)(f), effective January 1, 2015.

(2) This section was amended by 2011 c 171 § 70 and by 2011 c 243 § 1, each without reference to the other. Both amendments are incorporated in the publication of this section under RCW 1.12.025(2). For rule of construction, see RCW 1.12.025(1).

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 2. RCW 46.18.220 and 2015 c 200 s 3 are each amended to read as follows:Collector vehicle license plates. (Effective January 1, 2017.)
BillSection.P: (1) A registered owner may apply to the department, county auditor or other agent, or subagent appointed by the director for a collector vehicle license plate for a motor vehicle or travel trailer that is at least thirty years old. The motor vehicle must be operated primarily as a collector vehicle and be in good running order. The applicant for the collector vehicle license plate shall:
(a) Purchase a registration for the motor vehicle or travel trailer as required under chapters 46.16A and 46.17 RCW; and
(b) Pay the special license plate fee established under RCW 46.17.220(1)(f), in addition to any other fees or taxes required by law.
(2)(a) A person applying for a collector vehicle license plate for a vehicle manufactured in or before 1986 may:
(a) (i) Receive a collector vehicle license plate assigned by the department; or
(b) (ii) Provide an actual Washington state issued license plate designated for general use in the year of the vehicle's manufacture.

P.TextRun: (b) A person applying for a collector vehicle license plate for a vehicle manufactured in or after 1987 must be issued a collector vehicle license plate assigned by the department.

BillSection.P: (3) Collector vehicle license plates:
(a) Are valid for the life of the motor vehicle or travel trailer;
(b) Are not required to be renewed; and
(c) Must be displayed on the rear of the motor vehicle or travel trailer.
(4) A collector vehicle registered under this section may only be used for participation in club activities, exhibitions, tours, parades, and occasional pleasure driving.

(5) Collector vehicle license plates under subsection (2)(b) (a)(ii) of this section may be transferred from one vehicle to another vehicle described in subsection (1) of this section upon application to the department, county auditor or other agent, or subagent appointed by the director.

(6) Any person who knowingly provides a false or facsimile license plate under subsection (2)(b) of this section is subject to a traffic infraction and fine in an amount equal to the monetary penalty for a violation of RCW 46.16A.200(7)(b). Additionally, the person must pay for the cost of a collector vehicle license plate as listed in RCW 46.17.220(1)(f), unless already paid.
